note: COPY DECK, ENGLISH. ALL CAPS always. No em dashes, no exclamation marks, no emoji. THE REGISTER IS SPOKEN: the way a partier texts a friend, never marketing. Mirror the PT deck beat for beat; where PT uses VC/TBM texting forms, EN may use U and contractions. Read every line out loud before committing. The stamp is the last line of A GIFT, not a separate footer.

world.title: THE FLOOR
paragraphs: QIQI WAS BORN ON THE FLOOR AND BELONGS TO THE FLOOR.
SOME NIGHTS YOU'RE ON THE FLOOR WITH FRIENDS.

paragraphs.t: SOME NIGHTS THE FLOOR IS JUST YOU. THAT'S PART OF IT. QIQI DIDN'T COME TO FIX THAT.

close: PARTIES, LONELINESS, PEOPLE. ALL PART OF A MOMENT.
AND THE MOMENT PASSED. THAT'S WHAT MADE IT A MOMENT.

close.t: QIQI WILL NEVER BRING IT BACK. AND IT WILL NEVER LET YOU PRETEND IT DIDN'T HAPPEN.

items.head: IT TELLS YOU. IT NEVER CELEBRATES.
body: THE PARTY STARTS, IT TELLS YOU. THE SOUND STARTS, IT TELLS YOU. THAT'S IT.

items.head: LINE UP, PLACE, TIME. NOTHING ELSE.
body: CAPACITY IS JUST A NUMBER, SAID ONCE.

items.head: IT DOESN'T KEEP CALLING YOU BACK.
body: IT ONLY SPEAKS BECAUSE SOMETHING HAPPENED. DOORS OPENED. THE ADDRESS DROPPED. THE FLOOR CAUGHT FIRE.
IT WILL NEVER CALL YOU BACK BECAUSE IT MISSED YOU.

items.head: YOU SEE WHO'S GOING, NEVER HOW MANY.
body: NUMBERS HERE BELONG TO THE NIGHT. TIME, PRICE, TEMPERATURE, HOW MANY BLOCKS AWAY.

items.head: THE PHONE GOES BACK IN THE POCKET.
body: IF YOU SPENT THE NIGHT STARING AT THE APP, THE APP FAILED.

items.head: MEMORIES ARE LIKE TATTOOS, NEVER CONTENT.
body: THEY STAY ON THE APP FOREVER, EVERYONE SEES THEM.

items.head: TEXT ME WHEN YOU GET HOME.
body: THE ONE PART OF THE APP WITH ZERO STYLE. GETTING HOME, GETTING HELP, ALL SPELLED OUT.
EXIT SIGNS READ FROM ACROSS THE ROOM.

nevers.title: THE RULES
lines: NO FOLLOWERS, NO LIKES, NO RATINGS ON ANYONE.
NO COUNTDOWNS, NO HIDDEN PRICE TIERS.
NO RECOMMENDATION FEED, NO "TRENDING". THE CITY AND THE CLOCK ARE IN CHARGE.
EVERYTHING HERE ENDS. INCLUDING THE FEED.
NO AUTOPLAY. NO SCREEN BUILT TO KEEP YOU STARING.
NO ADS, NO DATA RESALE, NO REFERRAL CODES.
NOBODY TEACHES YOU HOW TO DANCE.
NO TOUR, NO QUIZ. YOU LEARN BY USING IT.
NO ROUNDED CORNERS. NO EMOJI. NO EXCLAMATION MARKS.

paragraphs.t: QIQI IS A GIFT FROM ME TO EVERYONE I EVER MET ON THE FLOOR. AND TO EVERYONE I NEVER WILL.

paragraphs: AN APP TO USE WITH FRIENDS. OR ALONE.
